title: Account Executive Product, Crypto/Stablecoins
location: SF, NYC
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Bridge team helps businesses build and scale stablecoin-powered financial products and global money movement through a single API. Our virtual accounts let international consumers and businesses access, store, and spend US dollars, while our payouts infrastructure helps platforms disburse funds globally.
We collaborate across product, compliance, legal, and operations as we develop Stripe Crypto’s go-to-market approach and build a durable sales culture. Our team has built financial infrastructure at Coinbase, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, and Airbnb, and we’re focused on making stablecoins a practical foundation for global payments.
What you’ll do
As an Account Executive (New Business), you’ll help grow Bridge by turning qualified demand and outbound prospecting into successful customer relationships. You’ll own the commercial journey from first conversation through launch, translating business and technical needs into practical solutions and working with internal partners to deliver strong outcomes. You’ll also use data and field insights to improve how the team sells and how Stripe Crypto scales.
Responsibilities
Close qualified inbound leads and develop outbound opportunities through networking, cold calling, and lead follow-up
Lead discovery conversations to understand prospects’ business needs and identify relevant Bridge solutions
Manage the full sales cycle, from identifying opportunities through negotiation and close, and partner with customers and internal teams to get them live
Build and maintain client relationships that support satisfaction, repeat business, and account growth
Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets while providing detailed and accurate sales forecasts
Collaborate with product, risk, operations, and other internal teams to deliver effective solutions for clients
Lead and contribute to team projects that develop and refine the sales process and help shape the Bridge and Stripe sales culture
Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
3-8 years of sales experience managing the full sales cycle for new accounts at a high-growth payments, financial technology, crypto, or technology company
A track record of exceeding sales quotas, closing net-new and upsell opportunities, and managing complex pricing or commercial negotiations
Experience using data to prioritize accounts, build business cases, and track outcomes, including familiarity with customer relationship management tools, Excel, and basic SQL, or demonstrated comfort with comparable data tools and analysis
Ability to understand technical product requirements, explain solutions across multiple technology products, and work with product, risk, and operations teams to deliver customer outcomes
Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to prioritize a high-volume territory and work persistently through ambiguity in a fast-paced environment
Enterprise AEs must be in their current role for a minimum of 24 months at the time of application.
Product Sales AE’s must be in their current role for a minimum of 24 months at the time of application.
Velocity AEs must be in their current role for a minimum of 18 months at the time of application.
Preferred qualifications
Experience managing a large book of accounts or a high-velocity sales motion
In-office Expectations
This is an in-office role. Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

title: Analytics Engineer
location: New York
description:
Who we are
About Privy
Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. We build simple, flexible developer tooling that make it easy to build products that put users first. By leveraging modern cryptography, we shift the status quo around digital ownership and protect the accounts and assets of millions of users.
Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone
About the Team
Data at Privy is not just about running queries or building reports. We transform messy, high-volume data into scalable systems and clear insights that guide product decisions and business strategy. We design pipelines that are resilient, models that are intuitive, and tools that make data accessible and trustworthy for everyone across the company. We believe in clean abstractions, transparency, and sharing our work so teammates can build on top of it. We push each other to ask sharper questions, test bold ideas, and follow the signal in the data so we can shape better products and empower our customers.
What you’ll do
In this role you’ll partner deeply with product, engineering, and GTM teams across Privy to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You’ll work daily with partners across the Privy business to extract insights and build pipelines from the rich and complex Privy data set which is a unique combination of SaaS and blockchain data. You’ll build data products, metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards and reports to inform and run the business. You’ll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling while also providing data infrastructure that allows users and stakeholders to self serve their own analyses.
Who you are
5+ years in an analytics engineering or data analyst role, preferably in a SaaS or developer tools environment.
Proficiency in SQL and data modeling techniques.
Experience with ETL processes and tools (e.g., Snowflake/Databricks, dbt, or similar).
Familiarity with analytics tools like Looker, Tableau, or similar BI platforms.
Familiarity with AI native tooling (e.g. claude code, codex, MCPs)
Experience with blockchain and/or payments transaction data and an understanding of common pitfalls when interacting with transactional data
Ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Comfortable working with cross-functional teams, presenting technical insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred qualifications
Experience in an API-based business and in payments, fintech, or crypto.
Experience directly supporting Product and Engineering teams as an embedded data analyst
Experience in launching new products in fast-paced, scaling environments.
Experience with data governance and ensuring data quality at scale.

title: Head of Global Partnerships and Startup and Ecosystem Product, Finance & Strategy
location: SF, NYC, SEA
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
Our team partners with Stripe’s Chief Business Officer and leaders across Global Partnerships and Startup and Ecosystem Product. Global Partnerships builds and manages relationships with banks, networks, payment methods, and other strategic partners that enable Stripe’s products and global expansion. The Startup and Ecosystem Product teams build tools and capabilities that help founders start and grow businesses and partners to extend Stripe products to better serve users across our entire ecosystem, respectively.
The Finance & Strategy team brings financial rigor, strategic clarity, and analytical depth to the decisions that shape Stripe’s business and long-term growth strategy. We act as a strategic finance function for complex commercial partner negotiations and work with product leaders to shape their strategy, growth, investment priorities, and financial performance as it scales. We help leaders evaluate partner economics, allocate resources, establish goals, and understand performance in order to turn complex analysis into clear recommendations.
What you’ll do
We’re looking for a finance leader to lead Finance & Strategy for Global Partnerships and Startup and Ecosystem Product. You’ll serve as a trusted financial and strategic advisor to the Chief Business Officer and other senior business leaders, connecting commercial decisions to their financial implications.
You’ll lead a team of strategic finance professionals to craft deal analysis and structure recommendations, investment frameworks, and strategic insights that drive long-term economic growth for Stripe. In addition, you will work cross-functionally to ensure disciplined financial planning and forecasting. You’ll develop the team, establish clear priorities, and balance time-sensitive deal support with recurring financial commitments and targeted strategic analysis.
Responsibilities
Lead the financial evaluation of complex product enablement partnerships. Partner with Global Partnerships leaders and Partner Development Managers to evaluate and execute commercial agreements with new and existing partners, bringing an independent financial perspective to negotiation strategy and decisions.
Guide deal economics and investment analysis. Oversee financial modeling, commercial benchmarking, scenario analysis, and investment cases. Translate complex deal structures into clear assessments of financial impact, risks, returns, and commercial trade-offs.
Improve partner economics and performance visibility. Develop data-driven insights to identify strategic and optimization opportunities for Stripe’s partner portfolio. Establish consistent frameworks and metrics to assess partner initiatives and deals.
Build investment cases in support of new business initiatives. Craft financial models in support of Startup and Ecosystem Product initiatives and establish objectives and metrics in partnership with Business and Product leaders.
Actively contribute to org building as part of the F&S leadership team. Help shape and execute F&S priorities, influence and drive cross-functional initiatives, and contribute to culture building of the organization.
Coordinate cross-functional financial recommendations. Work closely with Product and Engineering, Pricing, Strategy and Operations, Treasury Finance, Accounting, and other Finance & Strategy teams to support planning and forecasting activities.
Own the financial planning and forecasting cycle. Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and business reviews for Global Partnerships and Startup and Ecosystem Product areas.
Guide operating expense management. Maintain visibility into resource plans, assess investment and efficiency trade-offs, and surface material changes that require leadership decisions.
Partner on goals, metrics, and performance. Help leaders establish financial objectives and key business metrics for priority businesses and initiatives. Explain material deviations from plan, identify underlying drivers, and recommend actions.
Build and develop a high-performing team. Coach and develop direct reports, set clear expectations, and maintain high standards for analytical quality, business partnership, and execution.
Scale the team’s effectiveness. Improve financial models, reporting, planning processes, and analytical infrastructure. Use AI, automation, and better tooling to reduce manual work and create capacity for higher-value analysis.
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
15+ years in strategic finance, commercial finance, product finance, or FP&A, with demonstrated success leading and developing finance teams.
Strong commercial judgment and experience evaluating complex partnership agreements, building investment cases, and supporting negotiations through rigorous financial analysis.
Strong grounding in budgeting, forecasting, headcount and operating expense planning, and business performance management.
A proven ability to build trusted relationships with executives and cross-functional leaders, provide an objective perspective, and influence consequential decisions.
Exceptional analytical and financial modeling capabilities, with the ability to connect detailed economics to broader business strategy.
A hands-on leadership style and the judgment to prioritize across urgent transactions, recurring operating commitments, and longer-term strategic work.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting complex financial information and recommendations to senior leaders.
Comfort working with large, complex datasets, a working knowledge of SQL, and the ability to create structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.
Preferred qualifications
Experience at a high-growth payments company, fintech, or bank
Deep understanding of payments unit economics, including card networks, banks, and the role of partnerships in enabling financial products.
Prior experience in investment banking, private equity, or another transaction-oriented analytical role.
Experience using AI, automation, and financial planning or analytics tools to improve the quality and scalability of finance work.

We are builders first. We build custom tooling, automation frameworks, and internal platforms that scale our offensive work and make our assessments repeatable and high-fidelity. Increasingly, that includes AI agents that find and validate vulnerabilities at a scale no human team could reach. We believe the best offensive security engineers are equal parts hacker and engineer.
The team is distributed and works regularly with security, engineering, and product stakeholders across Stripe, including teams in Europe and Asia.

As a Staff Offensive Security Engineer on the Proactive Threat team, you'll set the technical direction for how Stripe tests itself the way a real adversary would. You'll own the strategy and the operating foundation of our red team program, including its tradecraft, infrastructure, rules of engagement, and coordination with detection and response. Set the multi-quarter technical strategy for offensive security at Stripe: where we test, how deep we go, and which threat actors and attack paths matter most to a financial infrastructure company
Define and own the red team program's operating foundation: rules of engagement, opsec standards, C2 and payload infrastructure, IR deconfliction, and repeatable engagement playbooks

Make fast, well-reasoned calls on scope, risk, and tradecraft, and explain them clearly to engineers, security leaders, and executives

Lead the team's most complex engagements yourself: objective-based red team operations, assumed-breach exercises, and deep assessments of critical payment, money-movement, cloud, CI/CD, and corporate systems

Find novel vulnerability classes and attack chains specific to Stripe's architecture, and turn them into systemic fixes rather than one-off findings
Scaling through engineering and automation
Design and build the offensive platforms, tooling, and agentic workflows that encode the team's expertise into repeatable, scalable systems
Apply LLMs and autonomous agents to reconnaissance, vulnerability discovery, exploit validation, and reporting, and set the bar for running them safely and reliably
Raise the engineering quality of the team's codebases through design reviews, code reviews, and example

Multiplying the team
Mentor and grow offensive security engineers at all levels, and raise the team's technical bar through pairing, design review, and knowledge sharing

title: Staff Software Engineer, Batch Compute
location: Seattle
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Batch Compute Experience team owns the platform that Stripe engineers use to build, run, debug and optimize Apache Spark jobs. Those jobs handle large-scale data processing for analytics, machine learning, finance and core product data pipelines. Hundreds of engineers and thousands of production jobs driving critical business processes, such as payouts and reconciliations, run on this platform.
Today, diagnosing and tuning a job means reasoning by hand across scattered telemetry, configuration, query plans and application code. Our goal is to make Spark at Stripe fast to iterate, reliable by default, and self-optimizing, so engineers can focus on business logic instead of Spark internals. We're doing this through three connected efforts:
Modernization : keeping Stripe's Spark runtime and dependency stack current, including Spark 3.5 → Spark 4, Scala 2.13 and Apache Iceberg. We're building automated upgrade and validation tools so that upgrading the whole fleet becomes routine and low-risk instead of a multi-year manual effort
Agentic Spark and optimization : building trustworthy, AI-powered workflows that diagnose failed or underperforming jobs, recommend fixes based on evidence, and carry them safely into configuration changes, code PRs or escalations. We also want to optimize configuration, query plans and code across the whole fleet
Operational excellence : making the platform reliable, observable and compliant, and defining user-experience metrics that show whether we're succeeding
Over the longer term, we want to turn the platform into a Spark control plane that keeps learning. It should detect problems before users notice them, validate fixes safely and apply them through policy-controlled automation.
What you’ll do
As a Staff Engineer on Batch Compute Experience, you'll set the technical direction for one of Stripe's most widely used data platforms. You'll lead multi-quarter efforts across teams, make high-stakes architectural decisions affecting thousands of production workloads, and raise the engineering bar for the team and its partners.
Responsibilities
Lead Spark modernization across the fleet. Own the technical strategy for moving thousands of production jobs to newer Spark and Iceberg runtimes. This includes target selection, qualification, deciding the rollout unit (cluster, application or hybrid), and rollback planning, while coordinating dependencies with partner infrastructure teams
Make upgrades continuous and safe. Design and evolve automated upgrade and validation systems: shadow execution against production data, output-correctness comparison, sandboxed execution, and staged promotion. The goal is to make each new runtime upgrade cheaper than the last
Architect agentic Spark workflows. Build LLM-powered systems that diagnose failures, out-of-memory errors (OOMs), data skew and performance regressions. They should produce evidence-backed recommendations that are backtested and gated in CI, and you'll define the safety, provenance and human-approval requirements for every automated action
Build safe configuration and remediation paths. Design authorized, validated, reversible no-code configuration changes, along with pipelines that detect anti-patterns across the fleet and open code-fix PRs or tickets
Drive efficiency at scale. Identify, prove out and roll out the highest-value configuration and query-plan optimizations, such as shuffle and adaptive query execution (AQE) tuning, executor sizing, join strategy and partitioning. Turn the measured gains into real infrastructure savings without hurting correctness or reliability
Improve the developer experience. Shorten the inner dev loop, improve PySpark support and observability (including Python memory diagnostics), and unify how jobs are packaged and launched across schedulers such as Airflow and Flyte
Set the technical bar. Lead critical design reviews, define reliability standards (SLOs, observability, testing) for the services we own, mentor senior engineers, and steer the team away from structural and operational debt
Who you are

title: Portfolio Manager, Commercial Operations
location: SF Bay Area/ Los Angeles
description:
PORTFOLIO MANAGER, COMMERCIAL OPERATIONS

Location: San Francisco Bay Area

About Tyba

Tyba is a modeling platform for energy companies developing, financing, and operating renewable energy infrastructure. Energy companies rely on technical models daily to make crucial infrastructure decisions and operate their assets.

Our mission is to make cutting-edge models accessible to cross-functional teams so that companies can build and operate more renewable energy more profitably. We are backed by leading climate and generalist VCs and work with many of the industry's most innovative energy companies.

The role

We're looking for a Portfolio Manager in the San Francisco Bay Area to join our Commercial Operations team. You'll manage revenue performance for a portfolio of battery storage assets that Tyba operates in wholesale power markets.

Each asset has a main performance target (for example, day-ahead TBx capture). You'll track how each asset does against its target, figure out why it's over- or underperforming, and work with customers and internal teams to improve it. You'll be the main point of contact for your customers and will work closely with our Market Operations, Market Analytics, Modeling, Sales, and Product teams.

Responsibilities

 - Manage revenue performance across your portfolio.
   
   - Review each asset's revenue and dispatch daily to catch recurring problems.
   
   - When an asset misses its target or cycles more or less than planned, analyze prices and dispatch to find out why, then get it fixed.
   
   - Work with Modeling and Market Analytics to improve performance. Report suspected model or forecast issues with supporting data, prioritize them by revenue impact, and use market insights to shape each customer's strategy.

 - Manage each customer's operating strategy.
   
   - Agree with the customer on each asset's operating strategy, including the performance target, baseline, operating limits, plans for high-value days, and when we can make manual changes.
   
   - Advise customers on specific needs such as warranty cycle limits, hedges, and congestion.

 - Manage the customer relationship.
   
   - Be the main point of contact for your accounts. Run biweekly performance meetings and quarterly executive business reviews (EBRs) on how assets are performing, what we're improving, and why.
   
   - Track account health and churn risk, own renewals, and share customer feedback and product gaps with Product and Engineering.

 - Lead implementations and find growth.
   
   - Lead onboarding for new customers and new assets from sales handoff to go-live, including account planning and complex asset and market integrations.
   
   - Spot expansion opportunities through your performance work and customers' goals, and pass them to the Account Executive.

Skills and experience:

 - Bachelor's degree (or foreign equivalent) in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or another quantitative field.

 - 5+ years in roles that combine analytical work with customer or stakeholder ownership, such as consulting, energy trading, asset management, or storage operations.

 - Learns new technical topics quickly and makes good decisions without much direction.

 - Experience leading complex technical integrations from start to finish, ideally working closely with engineering teams.

 - Track record of owning results.

 - Comfortable working with large timeseries datasets. Strong Excel skills; Python and API experience a plus.

 - Explains technical topics clearly to any audience and handles tough questions well.

 - Writes clear, polished materials for customers and executives.

 - Power markets experience strongly preferred, especially with battery storage.

Compensation and benefits:

 - Salary: $145K–$175K, depending on experience and qualifications.

 - Benefits: Parental leave, medical benefits, and unlimited PTO.

 - Equity Options: Opportunity to own a stake in the company through an employee stock option plan.

 - Flexible Work Environment: Hybrid work model for Bay Area-based team members, plus team offsites.

Our interview process focuses on core competencies. We want to make sure that you are set up for success at a fast-growing and high-impact startup. We will first get to know each other through conversations about Tyba, your background, and what you are looking for in your next role. While the specifics vary, from there, we will focus on evaluating your skills and experience relevant to the role. Once we have determined whether you are a fit for the team, we will help you get to know the company better and speak with other team members to inform your decision. We prioritize transparency, clear communication, and ensuring that we do our best to find a mutual fit.
